name: Date & Time
description: Parses text into timestamps, formats timestamps as text, or extracts a date part. The source column is kept and the result is appended as a new column.

column.title: Column
column.description: Input date/time column. Parse expects text; format and extract expect a timestamp or date.

output.title: Output column
output.description: Name of the appended result column.

op.title: Operation
op.description: parse turns text into a timestamp, format turns a timestamp into text, extract returns one date part as an integer.

format.title: Format
format.description: strptime/strftime pattern such as %Y-%m-%d. Required for parse and format.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Date part extracted when the operation is extract.
